description: Download full backup of a hosted website: action start (backupId from oma_backsies_list) builds a portable .tar.gz (files/ and database/*.sql, decrypted) on the hosting server and returns runId (follow with oma_backsies_status); action link (exportId = that runId) returns a download link valid for an hour while the export is kept (24 hours).

action.description: start (default) builds the download; link returns its URL.

domain.description: Site domain, e.g. example.fi, instead of serviceId.

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id. Pass this or domain.

name: oma_backsies_export
title: Download a full website backup
